name: Tenant 1 User accessing own tenant resource
query: query { resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Alice (101, Tenant 1) accesses her own Document #101. Fully authorized under tenant and owner isolation rules.

name: Tenant 2 User accessing own tenant resource
query: query { resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Bob (102, Tenant 2) accesses his own Document #102. Fully authorized under tenant and owner rules.

name: Cross-tenant access attempt: Bob accessing Alice document
query: query { resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Bob (102) attempts to read Alice's Document #101 across tenant boundary. BOLA cross-tenant violation.

name: Cross-tenant access attempt: Alice accessing Bob document
query: query { resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Alice (101) attempts to read Bob's Document #102 across tenant boundary. BOLA cross-tenant violation.

name: Held-out cross-tenant folder access: Bob accessing Alice Project Folder
query: query { resource(id: 201) { id name object_type } }
rationale: Bob (102) attempts to access Alice's Folder #201 in held-out set. Cross-tenant access must be blocked.

name: Held-out authorized tenant folder access: Alice accessing own Project Folder
query: query { resource(id: 201) { id name object_type } }
rationale: Alice (101) accesses her own Folder #201 in held-out set. Authorized owner access.

name: Admin cross-tenant oversight: Charlie reading Alice confidential document
query: query GetResourceAudit { resource(id: 101) { id name owner_id object_type } }
rationale: Charlie is an Admin (103). Policy Engine contains explicit ADMIN_OVERRIDE rule granting audit access.

name: Anonymous caller unauthenticated cross-tenant probing
query: query { resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Anonymous caller attempts to query Resource #101 without valid tenant principal. Must be denied.

name: Authorized nested profile resource enumeration: Alice -> Alice resources
query: query { user(id: 101) { id username resources { id name } } }
rationale: Alice queries her own user node and expands nested resources. Both user and resources belong to Alice.

name: Unauthorized nested profile enumeration: Bob -> Alice profile & resources
query: query { user(id: 101) { id username resources { id name } } }
rationale: Bob queries Alice's user profile (id 101) and nested resources. Unauthorized access to peer user entity.

name: Nested parent-child folder traversal: Alice accessing own folder children
query: query { resource(id: 201) { id name children { id name } } }
rationale: Alice queries her own Folder #201 and navigates to nested child documents. All objects owned by Alice.

name: Nested parent-child folder traversal: Bob accessing Alice folder children
query: query { resource(id: 201) { id name children { id name } } }
rationale: Bob attempts to traverse Alice's Folder #201 and children. Unauthorized BOLA at root folder.

name: Nested specific resource under user: Alice accessing own child resource
query: query { user(id: 101) { username resource(id: 101) { id name } } }
rationale: Alice accesses user(101) and nested resource(101). Both entities owned by Alice.

name: Nested BOLA pivot: Alice user root but accessing Bob nested resource
query: query { user(id: 101) { username resource(id: 102) { id name } } }
rationale: Alice uses authorized user(101) root but queries resource(102) owned by Bob. Classical nested BOLA pivot.

name: Deeply nested hierarchy traversal: Bob traversing nested children of Alice
query: query { user(id: 101) { resources { children { id name secret_key } } } }
rationale: Bob attempts deep AST traversal with secret_key extraction on Alice's object tree. Blocked at root.

name: Direct child document access without parent folder: Bob accessing Plan Alpha
query: query { resource(id: 202) { id name parent_id } }
rationale: Resource #202 is a child document in Alice's folder. Bob attempts direct ID access bypassing folder hierarchy.

name: Benign multi-alias query: Alice fetching two own resources with distinct aliases
query: query { note: resource(id: 101) { id name } folder: resource(id: 201) { id name } }
rationale: Alice queries two distinct resources she owns using aliases 'note' and 'folder'. Both permitted.

name: Single alias attack: Bob querying Alice document with alias
query: query { stolenDoc: resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Bob queries Alice's resource using alias 'stolenDoc'. Evidence correlation must attribute violation to 'stolenDoc'.

name: Partial authorization split: Bob queries own doc AND Alice doc in one query
query: query { myDoc: resource(id: 102) { id name } victimDoc: resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Bob mixes authorized 'myDoc' (102) with unauthorized 'victimDoc' (101). AST-runtime correlation must pinpoint 'victimDoc'.

name: Partial authorization split: Alice queries own doc AND Bob doc in one query
query: query { safeItem: resource(id: 101) { id } hostileItem: resource(id: 102) { id } }
rationale: Alice queries safeItem (101, benign) and hostileItem (102, unauthorized). Gateway denies overall, correlation isolates hostileItem.

name: Triple alias query with 2 safe objects and 1 hostile object
query: query { docA: resource(id: 101) { id } docB: resource(id: 201) { id } unauthorizedC: resource(id: 102) { id } }
rationale: Stress test: two allowed aliases (101, 201) and one unauthorized alias (102). Correlation precisely isolates unauthorizedC.

name: Aliased user nodes: Alice querying self vs Bob user profile
query: query { me: user(id: 101) { username } other: user(id: 102) { username } }
rationale: Alice queries self as 'me' and Bob as 'other'. 'other' is an unauthorized peer entity lookup.

name: Admin multi-alias sweep: Charlie querying Alice and Bob docs simultaneously
query: query { aliceDoc: resource(id: 101) { id name } bobDoc: resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Admin Charlie inspects multiple tenant docs using aliases. Both permitted under ADMIN_OVERRIDE.

name: Nested alias on child field under resource
query: query { target: resource(id: 101) { docName: name docSecret: secret_key } }
rationale: Bob queries Alice's document with field-level aliases docName and docSecret. Blocked at root target.

name: Authorized named query with fragment: Alice reading own document
query: fragment DocMeta on ResourceType { id name object_type } query FetchDoc { resource(id: 101) { ...DocMeta } }
rationale: Named query FetchDoc uses fragment DocMeta to retrieve own Document #101. Authorized.

name: Unauthorized named query with fragment: Bob reading Alice document
query: fragment DocMeta on ResourceType { id name object_type } query AttackDoc { resource(id: 101) { ...DocMeta } }
rationale: Bob executes named query AttackDoc with fragment spread on Alice's Document #101. BOLA violation.

name: Nested fragment expansion: Alice accessing Folder with children fragment
query: fragment ChildFields on ResourceType { id name } fragment FolderFields on ResourceType { id children { ...ChildFields } } query ReadFolder { resource(id: 201) { ...FolderFields } }
rationale: Chained fragment expansion (FolderFields -> ChildFields) for Alice's Folder #201. Permitted.

name: Nested fragment expansion attack: Bob accessing Alice folder with chained fragments
query: fragment ChildFields on ResourceType { id name } fragment FolderFields on ResourceType { id children { ...ChildFields } } query ExploitFolder { resource(id: 201) { ...FolderFields } }
rationale: Bob attempts chained fragment traversal on Alice's Folder #201. Direct BOLA violation at resource(201).

name: Multiple operations in document: execution targeted by operationName
query: query SafeQuery { resource(id: 101) { id } } query MaliciousQuery { resource(id: 102) { id } }
rationale: Document contains both SafeQuery and MaliciousQuery. Client executes MaliciousQuery targeting Bob's resource 102.

name: Inline fragment with type condition on sensitive field
query: query { resource(id: 101) { ... on ResourceType { id secret_key } } }
rationale: Bob uses inline fragment '... on ResourceType' to extract Alice's secret_key on Resource #101. Unauthorized BOLA.

name: Variable parameterized query: Alice accessing own resource via $id variable
query: query GetResource($id: Int!) { resource(id: $id) { id name } }
rationale: Alice supplies $id=101 matching her own document. Authorized.

name: Variable parameterized query: Bob accessing Alice resource via $id variable
query: query GetResource($id: Int!) { resource(id: $id) { id name } }
rationale: Bob supplies $id=101 pointing to Alice's document. Parameterized BOLA attack.

name: Nested variables: Alice accessing own user profile and own resource via variables
query: query GetUserResource($uid: Int!, $rid: Int!) { user(id: $uid) { username resource(id: $rid) { id name } } }
rationale: Alice supplies $uid=101 and $rid=101. Both targets owned by Alice. Authorized.

name: Nested variable BOLA injection: Alice accessing Bob resource via variable $rid
query: query GetUserResource($uid: Int!, $rid: Int!) { user(id: $uid) { username resource(id: $rid) { id name } } }
rationale: Alice supplies $uid=101 (own profile) but injects $rid=102 (Bob's resource). Nested variable BOLA.

name: Variable with AST default value fallback: Bob triggering default resource ID
query: query GetResourceDef($id: Int = 101) { resource(id: $id) { id name } }
rationale: Query defines AST default value $id=101. Bob passes empty variables, triggering default fallback to Alice's document.

name: Sanitized variable injection: Bob passing sensitive credential token alongside target ID
query: query GetResAuth($id: Int!, $authToken: String) { resource(id: $id) { id name } }
rationale: Bob targets Alice's document and injects authToken variable. Verifies taint sanitizer redacts token and blocks BOLA.

name: Non-existent resource ID lookup: Alice querying non-existent ID 999
query: query { resource(id: 999) { id name } }
rationale: Resource #999 does not exist in database. Policy Engine denies with OBJECT_NOT_FOUND. Benign non-existence, not an authorization breach.

name: Non-existent user entity lookup: Bob querying non-existent user 888
query: query { user(id: 888) { id username } }
rationale: User #888 does not exist. Handled safely as OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

name: Negative integer ID edge case: Bob querying resource ID -1
query: query { resource(id: -1) { id name } }
rationale: Negative object ID probe. Safely resolved as OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

name: Large 32-bit integer boundary probe: Resource ID 2147483647
query: query { resource(id: 2147483647) { id name } }
rationale: Maximum 32-bit signed integer boundary test. Handled gracefully without crash.

name: Non-existent resource ID lookup: Bob querying non-existent ID 999
query: query { resource(id: 999) { id name } }
rationale: Bob queries non-existent ID 999. Fails closed with OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

name: Zero integer ID probe: Resource ID 0
query: query { resource(id: 0) { id name } }
rationale: ID zero boundary test. Denied as OBJECT_NOT_FOUND.

name: Authorized mutation: Alice updating name of own Document #101
query: mutation UpdateDoc { update_resource(id: 101, name: "Alice Note Updated") { id name } }
rationale: Alice updates her own Document #101. Valid authorized mutation; state modification is permitted.

name: Unauthorized mutation BOLA: Bob attempting to update Alice Document #101
query: mutation MaliciousUpdate { update_resource(id: 101, name: "Defaced by Bob") { id name } }
rationale: Bob attempts unauthorized state change on Alice's Document #101. Mutation BOLA must be blocked with zero state change.

name: Unauthorized delete BOLA: Bob attempting to delete Alice Document #101
query: mutation MaliciousDelete { delete_resource(id: 101) }
rationale: Bob attempts to delete Alice's Document #101. Highly destructive BOLA mutation. Must be denied.

name: Authorized delete mutation: Alice deleting own child document
query: mutation AuthorizedDelete { delete_resource(id: 203) }
rationale: Alice deletes her own child document #203. Authorized deletion (evaluated safely with fixture rollback).

name: Unauthorized ownership transfer: Bob transferring Alice document to Bob
query: mutation HijackOwnership { transfer_ownership(id: 101, new_owner_id: 102) { id owner_id } }
rationale: Bob attempts to hijack ownership of Alice's Document #101 via transfer_ownership mutation. Hostile BOLA.

name: Admin authorized resource update: Charlie updating Bob Document #102
query: mutation AdminUpdate { update_resource(id: 102, name: "Admin Verified") { id name } }
rationale: Admin Charlie updates Bob's Document #102. Authorized under ADMIN_OVERRIDE policy.

name: Authorized mutation with variable: Bob updating own document #102
query: mutation UpdateMyDoc($id: Int!, $name: String!) { update_resource(id: $id, name: $name) { id name } }
rationale: Bob updates his own Document #102 using parameterized mutation variables. Fully authorized.

name: Unauthorized mutation with variable: Alice updating Bob document #102
query: mutation UpdatePeerDoc($id: Int!, $name: String!) { update_resource(id: $id, name: $name) { id name } }
rationale: Alice supplies $id=102 pointing to Bob's document in update_resource mutation. Parameterized mutation BOLA.

name: Partial authorization: Alice reading health check (public) AND Bob document (restricted)
query: query { health { status } resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Public health field is safe, but resource(102) is unauthorized BOLA. Correlated defense isolates resource(102).

name: Partial authorization: Bob reading health check (public) AND own document (authorized)
query: query { health { status } resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Both fields are authorized for Bob (public health check + own resource #102). Entire query permitted.

name: Multi-root query: Alice reading own user entity AND Bob document
query: query { user(id: 101) { username } resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Root user(101) is authorized, but root resource(102) is unauthorized. Correlation isolates resource path.

name: Multi-root query: Alice reading own user entity AND own document
query: query { user(id: 101) { username } resource(id: 101) { id name } }
rationale: Both roots user(101) and resource(101) belong to Alice. Both permitted.

name: Multi-root query: Bob reading own user entity AND Alice folder
query: query { user(id: 102) { username } resource(id: 201) { id name } }
rationale: Bob's user node is safe, but Alice's folder 201 is denied. Correlation distinguishes user from resource.

name: Admin multi-root query: Charlie reading user 101 and resource 102
query: query { user(id: 101) { username } resource(id: 102) { id name } }
rationale: Admin Charlie executes multi-root query across multiple users/resources. Allowed under ADMIN_OVERRIDE.

name: Malformed syntax: Unclosed selection braces
query: query { resource(id: 101) { id name
rationale: Syntax error: unclosed braces. Parser must raise GraphQLSyntaxError and reject immediately.

name: Malformed syntax: Missing argument value
query: query { resource(id: ) { id } }
rationale: Syntax error: missing argument value. Rejected as MALFORMED.

name: Malformed syntax: Empty query document
rationale: Empty document payload. Rejected as MALFORMED.

name: Malformed syntax: Illegal characters in query selection
query: query { resource(id: 101) { id @@@ } }
rationale: Syntax error: illegal tokens '@@@' inside selection set. Rejected as MALFORMED.
